The pinned hash checks the SHIPPED default (JIT16=1, JIT16_486=1, IZARRAVM_WATCH_PAGE_BIT default on). As of this re-pin the default arm, the arm-off value and --interpreter all agree on af6c23e0..., so frame_sha256 and frame_sha256_interpreter are equal for the first time; keep both fields, since a future JIT-mix change can separate them again.
